Develop and create paginated reports and relevant dashboards that aid senior management and other departments in making informed decisions.
Maintain internal data warehouse tables and views, creating and changing as required.
Investigate and implement innovative and next-generation insight services, including the use of dashboards, ad-hoc visualizations, and other technologies.
Perform other information systems functions to support the business as needed.

None

Master’s degree, preferably in information system or related field.

Proficient with T-SQL and SQL Server Management Studio
Fluent with querying with joins and unions

Job Description
The Product Owner will be assigned as a member of Team Sentinel (Advanced Backlog Grooming group) and report to the Requirements Manager. The Product Owner will be integrated into a development or sustainment team implementing Agile methodologies to create web application functionality, where the PO serves as the subject matter expert. The PO understands the functional goals and requirements of the web application features under development or sustainment, and fulfills the role of representing the customer in ensuring these are met. In order to achieve this, the PO grasps how the end user applies the software in an operational environment or setting; so, familiarity with the mission operations of AMC and/or USTRANSCOM and how the applications would be used in a business context is very useful. The PO interacts regularly with program leadership to provide updates on achievements, obstacles, risks, and other issues related to overall program success. Formulate and define system scope and objectives to meet business requirements and customer objectives.
Support feature grooming through Team Sentinel grooming sessions based on prioritized backlog items.
Based on customer-provided priorities, groom features for development and/or sustainment team assignment.
“Own” the Acceptance Criteria of product features after they have been assigned to the development and/or sustainment team.
With input from Team Sentinel, end user representatives, Solution Architect, and stakeholders, build and edit user stories, defects, and enablers.
Collaborate with the development and/or sustainment team to create and detail stories that sufficiently address all the Acceptance Criteria in the assigned feature and ensure acceptance tests are written.
Prioritize user stories in the “Team Backlog” to streamline the execution of program priorities.
Maintain the conceptual and technical integrity of user stories and each component within a user story.
Provide quality control by being the only team member empowered to accept stories as “Done” and ready for presentation for Government acceptance.
Ensure the creation of mockups and visuals to demonstrate development functionality and capabilities
Serve as the liaison between Team Sentinel, stakeholders and development and/or sustainment teams.
Work with project managers, developers, test engineers, customer representatives, and end users to ensure the web application design and functionality meets business requirements and expectations.

Participate in meetings as required to facilitate the continuous release of value-added solutions for requirements.

job_summary:
The Business Analyst provides analysis to support the documentation, development, and maintenance of applications and website for Merchants. This individual will work with other business analysts, business process engineers, subject matter experts, and Agile development teams to document business rules/requirements, maintain/enhance existing systems, build new applications, brainstorm fixes and solutions, create features and user stories, and support the development team in implementation.
This individual will leverage a deep understanding of the Agile framework and software development lifecycle, in collaboration with the product team and Application Architects, to break down features into clear and accurate user stories and supporting artifacts.
This position is focused on a finance-based project that will have this individual working closely with finance teams internally. Knowledge of capital funding, asset backed securities, and prior experience with finance projects or implementations is preferred.
What Your Day Looks Like
Works closely with the project team (finance focused) to translate product management strategy, goals and directives for new products and product enhancements into clear and actionable features/user stories for the technology team
Provides complex analysis and problem solving on software development business challenges and customer support issues including talking to customers, scoping, root-cause, brainstorming with the team, clarifying options, documenting product operations, and creating innovative cost-effective solutions
Partnering with the Product Owners and Subject Matter Experts to gather requirements, and responsible for writing features, user stories (capturing business requirements and functional specifications), creating UI wireframes and mockups, and serving as the product owner for systems related questions during scrum meetings.
Refines and communicates new development features and user stories in a way that the team can pick up quickly; discusses priority and technical issues with the scrum team
Supports the development team by responding to user story questions quickly and accurately, and gathering details for Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs)
Partners with user experience designers, as needed
Responsible for ticket triaging, differentiation between bugs and enhancements, product knowledge, and defect management support including organizing and executing user acceptance testing
Assists with product backlog grooming sessions, schedules appropriate ad-hoc product design sessions, coordinates with lead developer and team on estimation sessions, summarizes work in sprint demos, and participates in retrospectives
Leads and facilitates general meetings, product trainings, and collaborative workshop methods with a mix of both business and technical partners
Partners with Business Process Engineers on Process Mapping and Improvement: Documents existing processes with a keen eye for identifying waste, gaps, risks, value added areas and opportunities, if needed performs this function individually
Analyzes current state processes with a holistic view of the organization and partners to design new future state processes
Documents product build out as needed for future maintenance and development needs
Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned
After hours and on-call work is required at critical times, particularly during a deployment
Ability to travel upon request to visit business partners as needed
The Skills You Bring
Strong meeting facilitation, presentation, training and workshop facilitation skills
Ability to develop effective relationships across the business
Motivated self-starter with the ability to learn quickly and work with teams as well as individually
Outstanding written and verbal communicator and interpersonal skills
Detail oriented and strong analytical skills
Strong systems aptitude and ability to leverage technology to drive customer satisfaction
LEAN/Continuous improvement mindset
MS Office
Experience using Miro collaboration tool a plus
1 year of Working Knowledge in Azure DevOps, Jira or used equivalent tool
UI Prototyping or Mockup tools (Balsamiq, Axure, Visio, Adobe, etc.)
1 year of interpreting data using SQL queries
The Expertise And Education You Have
A minimum of 4+ years’ experience performing analysis in a software development environment, including Agile, and Lean Startup
Prior financial experience – capital funding, asset backed securitization
Working knowledge of Agile, LEAN, or other product management methodologies
Process analysis and mapping experience
Delivering trainings, presentations, running meetings and workshop facilitation
Experience as a Business Analyst for an Automotive or Fleet product is a plus
CSPO certification, or experience as a Product Owner in an Agile framework is a nice to have
Education
Computer Science, Information Technology, Business or related field

Collaborates with Marketing on developing targeted, value-based growth and retention strategies.

Are you curious, motivated, and forward-thinking? At FIS you’ll have the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging and relevant issues in financial services and technology. Our talented people empower us, and we believe in being part of a team that is open, collaborative, entrepreneurial, passionate and above all fun.
About The Team
The Process Optimization and Technology Enablement team sits within Purchasing Operations. The team oversees the end to end Purchasing function, related tools and processes. We provide the strategic direction for growth and optimization of system functionality and related processes. Daily team responsibilities include oversight and maintenance of the integrations with upstream and downstream systems, periodic cloud patch management, system enhancements, supplier catalogs system testing. The team also manages the onboarding and divestiture of FIS entities as it relates to purchasing activity. Future expansion to engage more broadly to additional Supply Chain Management (SCM) utilized tools.
About The Role
As an ERP Business Analyst, will look to use analytics and engagement with business users, and the SCM teams to identify areas for optimization or to address challenges with the current processes. You will be a subject matter expert for the global purchasing function. You’ll work as part of a team, with specific areas of responsibly and must be a self- motivated, proactive, and out-of-the-box thinker. You will elicit, analyze, communicate, and validate business/user requirements for processes, policies and information systems.

Engage with IT analysts to review system functionality to solution technical challenges.
Identify system configuration changes to enhance the user experience and to provide added controls for the purchasing function.
Participate in discussions and manage activities related to upstream system integrations.
Preparing and analyzing data purchasing data with the object to identify ways to optimize the purchasing process or to address opportunities for technology enhancements.
Perform analysis, testing and oversight of significant changes to purchasing data for conversion between systems due to acquisitions, divestitures, or system upgrades.
Solution design testing in Pre-production environments and validation of design in Production.
Stay current with technology enhancement options by participating on ERP and SCM system reviews and discussions with the Suppliers.
Develop and maintain Process maps and training documentation.
Train and support SCM team member and business users.
What You Will Need
A bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Finance/Accounting, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
3-5 years of Business analyst or purchasing operations experience.
Understanding of enterprise purchasing processes (Procure to Pay function), general understanding of Sourcing and Accounts Payable are helpful.

Experience in process mapping and documentation.
Logical reasoning using data to identify areas for process/system optimization.
Excellent problem solving and time management skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills to technical and non-technical audiences of various levels in the organization, e.g., executive, management, individual contributors.

job_summary:
Capio Group is looking for an experienced Salesforce Business Analyst
Full-time employee - Remote
About Us:
Since 2010, we have been working with some of the largest government agencies in California, helping them to solve their greatest challenges. We are a small firm dedicated to big ideas and enjoy the rewards that come from hard work and commitment to our client base. We offer the salary and benefits of the bigger companies with the added bonus of a flexible workplace and a great work-life balance.
Scope of Work:
Capio Group is looking for a Salesforce Business Analyst to work as part of the team to provide implementation services for the client’s system:
Develop the client’s Salesforce Architecture based on the client’s Enterprise Architecture Common Business Processes, Master Data Management, client’s Business Needs, Functional and Non-Functional Requirements, and Interfaces with external client’s program partners.
Provide the ability to make changes to one business area/application without causing side-effects to other business areas.
Ensure the information/data entered into the system is complete and consistent by implementing and enforcing business rules when any information is captured.
Place tighter controls on changes to all information and data within the system through the establishment of a data governance process that approves all changes to the systems’ data.
Provide a standardized set of interfaces implemented through a common interface subsystem, where information can be transmitted to external entities, and the interface can be quickly tailored to individual stakeholder needs.
Ensure all information is tightly related and all changes to the information are traceable to who made the change, when the change was made, and what change was made.
Provide the business with the capability to track a case from initiation through completion that allows the review of related current and historical data from all programs within the client.
Provide management with management reporting capabilities to review staff workload, performance, and activities.
Provide management with the ability to perform trend analysis on activities and active results to identify high-risk areas where actions, such as increased inspections, could be performed to minimize risks to animal health and food safety.
Allow all public program applicants to submit applications and payment through an online service.
Allow applicants and business owners to review their data, inspection results, actions underway, etc. online.
The Salesforce Business Analyst’s primary duties is to translate what the client’s business needs and how to get this accomplished within the Salesforce solution by asking why and how the client’s stakeholders do their key business processes. In addition, the role of a Salesforce Business Analyst is to gather and/or confirm business needs to prepare User stories, produce "to-be" process maps, and document detailed reasons why something was implemented. Other key activities that this role performs are a gap analysis, preparing user acceptance test plans, and participating in stakeholder communication.
Mandatory Experience:
Must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or Business Management from an accredited college or university. Additional qualifying experience may be substituted for the bachelor’s degree on a year-for-year basis. A copy of the diploma must be provided upon request.
Four (4) years of experience can be substituted for a bachelor's degree. The substituted experience must be in addition to the required years of experience. Example: If the experience requirement is five (5) years, and the individual is substituting four (4) years of experience in lieu of a bachelor's degree, a total of nine (9) years must be submitted to claim this qualification
For degree qualifications, if the degree is not in English, it must be accompanied by a translation performed by a member of the National Association of Credential Evaluation Services (NACES).
Within the last 7 years, must have a minimum of three (3) years of full-time equivalent (FTE) experience as a Salesforce Business Analyst on a Salesforce implementation project.
A minimum of one (1) year of FTE experience as a Business Solutions Analyst on a Salesforce Public Sector - Government implementation project.
A minimum of five (5) years of FTE experience as a Salesforce Business Analyst for a Salesforce SaaS implementation, a project budget of at least $10 million, and a project duration of at least two (2) years in Calif. State Government.
Must have certification as a Salesforce Business Analyst. A copy of the certificate must be provided upon request.
Must be able to provide two (2) references for similar services within the last five (5) years. At least one (1) reference must be from experience used to meet Minimum Qualifications and cannot use the same reference more than once.
Desirable Experience :
Must be certified by the International Institute of Business Analysis (IIBA) as a Certified Business Analyst (CBAP). A copy of the active certificate must be provided upon request.
Within the last ten (10) years, a minimum of one (1) year (up to 5 years) of FTE experience implementing Salesforce. The Salesforce application system must be for a state, county or city government with a population greater than 1,000,000 people.
Within the last ten (10) years, a minimum of one (1) year (up to 5 years) of FTE experience implementing Salesforce Public Sector Solutions.
Within the last ten (10) years, a minimum of one (1) year (up to 5 years) of FTE experience of State of CA Technology Implementation project experience.
Within the last ten (10) years, a minimum of one (1) year (up to 5 years) of FTE experience implementing other State & Local Government projects.
Equal Opportunity Employer:
At Capio Group, our employees are our greatest asset and diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core of who we are. Our commitment to these values is unyielding and is central to our mission and to our impact. We know that having diverse perspectives helps to generate better ideas to solve the complex problems of our diverse clients and the communities they serve.

Description
Ardelyx was founded with a mission to discover, develop and commercialize innovative, first-in-class medicines that meet significant unmet medical needs. Ardelyx has two commercial products approved in the United States, IBSRELA®(tenapanor) and XPHOZAH® (tenapanor), as well as early-stage pipeline candidates.
Manager/ Senior Manager, G&A Business Analyst
Position Summary
We are seeking a talented and motivated Manager/Senior Manager level G&A Business Analyst to support the Finance, HR, Supply Chain and Corporate Communications functions of our commercial stage biotech company. The successful candidate will be responsible for analyzing complex business problems and providing data-driven insights to senior management to drive strategic decision making across these key corporate functions.
Position Responsibilities
Conduct in-depth analysis of financial, HR, supply chain and corporate communications data to identify trends, patterns and insights that can inform key business decisions.
Work with business stakeholders to develop business requirements and process improvements to drive operational efficiencies and cost savings.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement process improvements and ensure successful execution of business strategies.
Develop and maintain business performance metrics to track progress against key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide regular reports to senior management.
Prepare and deliver presentations to senior leadership to communicate findings, insights and recommendations.
Ensure accuracy, completeness and consistency of data across all business systems and processes.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders to ensure effective collaboration and communication.
Conduct benchmarking and industry research to identify best practices and trends in G&A functions.
Develop and maintain data models to support scenario planning, budgeting and forecasting.
Collaborate with IT to identify opportunities to automate and streamline business processes.
Lead cross-functional projects and initiatives to support strategic business goals.
Provide training and support to business users on new systems, processes and tools.
Serve as a subject matter expert on G&A processes and systems, providing guidance and support to business stakeholders.
Analyze and evaluate the effectiveness of existing G&A policies and procedures and recommend improvements.
Position Requirements
BA/BS, MBA a plus
8+ years of experience in commercial analytics or related field.
Experience in direct-to-patient and digital marketing
Strong analytical skills with the ability to gather, analyze and interpret data from multiple sources.
Experience working with financial systems, ERP systems, and other business software applications.
Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to effectively communicate complex ideas to non-technical audiences.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
Knowledge of biotech/pharmaceutical industry preferred.
Experience with market research, forecasting, and data analysis.
Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to present complex data to senior leadership.
Demonstrated ability to work in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
Combination of strong strategic thinking with ability to execute tactical plans
Ability to effectively and consistently execute multiple projects simultaneously
Excellent interpersonal, collaboration, and leadership skills
Proven track record for consistently meeting or exceeding goals and objectives
The anticipated annualized base pay range for this full-time position is $131,850 to $161,150. Ardelyx utilizes industry data to ensure that our compensation is competitive and aligned with our industry peers. Actual base pay will be determined based on a variety of factors, including years of relevant experience, training, qualifications, and internal equity. The compensation package may also include an annual bonus target and equity awards, subject to eligibility and other requirements.
Ardelyx also offers a robust benefits package to employees, including a 401(k) plan with generous employer match, 12 weeks of paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks living organ and bone marrow leave, equity incentive plans, health plans (medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision), life insurance and disability, flexible time off, annual Winter Holiday shut down, and at least 11 paid holidays.

Our process is collaborative and team-based, but people are given freedom to do their job as they see fit, with the understanding that we’re all ultimately accountable for our performance. There are no investment superstars in the firm, and everyone’s doors are always open. Analysts are expected to source new ideas, look for inflections (along the key vectors of our investment process) on our coverage lists, discover and drive investment process improvements, and help those around them make good decisions. Undergraduate degree from an Ivy league school – just kidding, that will be used against you.

At Republic Finance, we are building a leading consumer lending company. In business for more than 70 years, we are proud to be a trusted lender in over 250 communities across the United States! We specialize in providing flexible lending solutions and incomparable customer service. Driven by our shared mission to pursue excellence for our team, our customers, and our performance, Republic Finance is continuously improving our online customer offerings in tandem with opening more branches in new states each year. We also regularly promote from within and enjoy giving back to the communities we serve. In a nutshell, our company culture is about helping customers, investing in our employee's future, and ensuring that our overall performance makes an impact on our community.
We are seeking a Sr. Business Analyst for our Operations Analytics and Loss Mitigation Strategy team. This is a key role with significant and broad responsibilities and will be a member of a 3-4 person team with substantial opportunity for future growth within the company in concert with driving business expansion. As a team-member responsible for developing recovery strategies that balance growth, risk and profitability, you will be a key thought leader on all collections strategies and decisions and have significant input into all loss mitigation decisions and delinquency performance. You will work closely with operations, Branch managers, and internal/external partners to collaborate on broader strategic initiatives and shape the direction and growth of the overall business in a collaborative dynamic team environment. Come and be a part of our success story! Job responsibilities are as follows:
Continuously challenge and enhance loss mitigation strategies and scorecards through analysis of customer behavior data and sophisticated statistical and financial modeling.
Maintain a rigorous performance monitoring framework and management dashboards to highlight performance trends and areas of opportunity.
Develop best-in-class loss mitigation products that provide our consumers solutions while minimizing portfolio risk.
Establish a robust test and learn environment for continual loss mitigation and collections strategy improvement.
Build and maintain a robust economic framework that will serve as the foundation for business decision-making.
Ensure loss mitigation policy remains compliant with all applicable laws and regulations.
Maintain transparent communication and trust with all key stakeholders.
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in a STEM major is required, advanced degree is preferred.
2-4 years of experience as an analyst in lending originations or loss mitigation.
Experience with statistical modeling and forecasting, portfolio P&L simulation, vintage profitability tracking and marginal expansion strategies.
Familiarity with loss mitigation and collections strategies, loss forecasting, and/or collections KPI’s
1+ years of experience with SQL and/or Python querying required.
Strong communication and presentation skills, leadership skills, a high level of initiative, intellectual curiosity and creativity
A robust understanding of the consumer lending business that includes the various facets of a specialty lending operation.
Familiarity with conducting monthly loan-level and segment-level delinquency forecasts.

We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package including:
Health/Dental/Vision
Paid Time Off (PTO)
401 (K) and employer match
Company provided Life Insurance & Long Term Disability
Additional benefits with Republic Finance include:
Employee of the Month Program
Philanthropic support for charities such as Juvenile Diabetes Research Foundation and the American Cancer Society
Professional offices with a friendly team environment

Who we are:
Atkore is forging a future where our employees, customers, suppliers, shareholders, and communities are building better together – a future focused on serving the customer and powering and protecting the world.
With a global network of manufacturing and distribution facilities, Atkore is a leading provider of electrical, safety and infrastructure solutions.
Who we are looking for:
We’re looking for an experienced JD Edwards ERP Manufacturing expert to help us transform our North American operations to a single and common JD Edwards-enabled solution. The Business Analyst will be the primary contact person for everything related to the current JD Edwards ERP system, including becoming familiar with the business processes and requirements that drive how the ERP system is implemented, deployed, and updated. Ultimately, this position is responsible for Atkore’s ongoing Manufacturing and RF Smart Scanning functionality, service, and support. This person will report to the Manager of IT Manufacturing and Procurement and will work closely with all ERP user groups across Atkore including Sales, Finance, Customer Service, Transportation, Procurement, Order Management, Warehousing and Distribution.
The primary responsibility of this position will be to spend 24-36 months deploying JD Edwards across our North American facilities. As a result, we expect this position will require 25-30% travel for the first 2 years, then 10-15% travel per year afterward.
What you’ll do:
ERP Digital Roadmap Support:
Act as IT leader responsible for the successful design, build, test, and implementation of Atkore’s North American Manufacturing solution.
Support the incremental and phased implementation of the Manufacturing solution across multiple facilities.
Become Atkore’s solution expert for future digital roadmap efforts.
ERP Support and Implementation:
Initiate and lead ERP-related projects and enhancements for North American operations.
Thoroughly understand company business practices and procedures in order to design, develop and maintain automated workflow processes.
Work with ERP systems users and management across the organization to determine appropriate system configuration and setup.
Create documentation and procedural guidelines for ERP systems users.
ERP Maintenance & Ongoing Development:
Provide day to day support to ERP users.
Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve ERP system issues reported by end users.
Design, develop and maintain reports used by ERP systems users.
Understand ERP security subsystem in order to assign appropriate system access to users at different levels throughout the organization and its partners.
Maintain current knowledge and understanding of ERP applications and computer hardware operating systems.
Conduct in-depth tests for modified and new systems or applications.
Produce user documentation for applications developed.
Customer Partnership and Support:
Participate in internal Lean and Kaizen events in customer areas.
Support customer initiatives and operational activities.
Attend customer KPI reviews and meetings as requested.
Perform other duties as assigned.
What you bring:
A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related/relevant field.
Strong business knowledge of the J.D. Edwards EnterpriseOne 9.2 (“JDE ERP”) package with specific focus on Manufacturing, RF Smart(Data Collection), and all Master Data related to it.
5 to 7 years’ experience implementing enterprise IT applications, defining and mapping business processes, and understanding integration between various applications. It’s also a plus if you have experience with distributed application development in a client/server environment.
A proven record of strong internal customer service, on-time and on-budget completion of projects and enhancements, and continuous improvement of the capabilities within your function.
Large scale, multi-site, program implementation experience and PMP certification (we aren’t requiring these, but we do prefer them).
A formal structured problem-solving certification such as Six Sigma (this would be a plus).
Strong business acumen and understanding of business operations, along with good communication and documentation skills, and experience working with all levels of staff to define business and technical requirements.
An ability to get support and buy-in for recommendations and decisions.
Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to deliver commitments while managing multiple priorities. This will require familiarity with the development life cycle and its implementation.
Within 3 months, you’ll:
Complete your new hire “Immersion” so that you are ready to rock in your new role.
Become acquainted and comfortable with the JDE BA team.
Have developed relationships with the key stakeholders for this role.
Be well-versed in Atkore’s procurement processes as well as business and IT solutions.
Be able to provide limited customer support for production and continuous improvement activities.
Start to participate with the ERP deployment teams focused on implementing JD Edwards across our North American Operations
Within 6-months, you’ll:
Have started to become a subject matter expert for Atkore-specific business processes and IT solutions.
Be a competent and comfortable in problem-solving and providing full production support with limited assistance.
Be able to make recommendations regarding business processes and IT solutions.
Be deploying JD Edwards, spending time on-location at the implementation sites, engaging users directly
Within 12-months, you’ll:
Completely own Atkore’s Manufacturing solution portfolio.
Autonomously make decisions regarding the JDE solution and be seen as a go-to person for problem solving and support
Be able to strategically identify needed improvements, changes, and modifications and turn those ideas into action.

Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned, as necessary.
Proficient in Discrete & Lean Manufacturing, Product Data Management, Inventory Management, Shop Floor Management, Forecasting, Demand Planning, MRP & MPS, Material & Capacity Planning, Product Costing & Manufacturing Accounting, Quality Management, Procurement.

Job Title: Business Analyst II
Location: Swiftwater, PA
Duration: 24 months
Job Description
The
Professional Contract Administrator
is responsible for the processing and loading of contracts, amendments, discontinuations and other required changes to contracts. This position communicates contract awards, prices, products, terms and renewals to internal and external customers (i.e. contract owners, wholesalers, sales force, etc.). The position serves as the contract liaison between Contract Development & Analytics, Account Management, and Customer Service in communicating contract information.
Works with Account Managers, CD&A Contract Manager and the CD&A Director to process, gain approval(s), deliver and complete associated record keeping associated with all contract correspondence (i.e. contracts, amendments, UCRs, etc.) within client guidelines. This position possesses the authority to approve these documents for presentation to the customer. This requires a thorough knowledge of client strategies and policies regarding private sector pricing and contracting.
After the contract award, responsible for assuring accurate pricing, appropriate approvals, membership eligibility, wholesaler notification, and resolving problems which may arise during contract term. Accuracy is critical as it ensures accounts get the correct pricing and set up so that payment terms and fees are calculated correctly. It also proactively prevents chargeback errors from occurring. Additionally, this entire process ensures good working relationships with the contract holder and others in the CD&A team for the next series of negotiations.
The Client has over 1000 active contracts all with unique dates, terms, pricing, fees, etc. This position is responsible for facilitating updates to the contract database of all key pieces of information so that internal and external customers are properly and timely informed and key pieces of language are implemented timely for contracts. The number of contracts being managed is growing exponentially.
Responsible for resolving contract problems and customer inquiries. This is done through analysis and review of information versus contractual language, terms and conditions. These responses will be in a timely manner through composed written replies or direct discussions with the customer.
Overall responsibility for process of communicating and validating contract pricing to authorized wholesalers in timely manner. This includes, but is not limited to, resolving price discrepancies with wholesalers in timely manner. In addition, this position is the liaison between Contract Development, Account Management and Accounts Payable in resolving chargeback discrepancies based on pricing.
Responsible for developing and gaining approval on templates associated with price changes and new/discontinued products. Also, responsible for routing all documents for AAF (legal) approval and signature.
To Be Successful In This Role The Individual Must
Be very detail-oriented, accurate and organized.
Be proficient at applying policies to real case situations.
Network with other areas to resolve problems and often times to gain appropriate approvals.
Utilize SAP, Word, and Excel to manage the contracts appropriately.
Have excellent time management skills.
Excellent written/oral communication skills, problem solving, analytical skills.
Have a very high level of attention to detail and accuracy.
Basic Qualifications:
BA/BS (preferred) in Finance, Accounting, Marketing or Business Administration/Management with 2-4 years business experience.

The scopes of work define the applicable boundaries, requirements, activities/tasks, deliverables/milestones, terms and conditions, etc. for purchasing goods/services.
The BA will incorporate or gather requirements and related exhibits/appendices.
BA will collaborate with business, IT, IT Security, Legal, and Procurement/Legal stakeholders.

BA will assist in gathering and documenting selection criteria for proposal evaluations.

Consultant will be preparing materials to support procurements but will not be participating in the actual GDOT evaluation, selection, or contracting processes.

The BA will work hand-in-hand with business, project, and management teams.

BA will translate user need into materials for successful IT initiation, design, and development.
BA will conduct user interviews and joint-application-development (JAD) sessions.
BA will identify business "pain points" and rank user stories/use cases potential to improve business effectiveness/performance.

BA will actively participate in the software development life cycle (SLDC) and transfer information to IT Project teams.

Description
Under general direction of the Information Technology (IT) Manager, the IT Business Analyst - BIPIN provides application support and testing and training for the regional Bi-County Police Information Network (BIPIN). This includes responsibility for eliciting requirements, analyzing, specifying and validating the business needs of BIPIN system users; identifies opportunities to streamline and standardize business processes (where applicable) and makes recommendations to business process stakeholders; identifies opportunities to leverage technology to improve the efficiency and effectiveness. The position requires documenting, communicating, testing, and training changes needed based on best practices. Responsibilities also include; mapping existing processes in order to identify areas for improvement, prepares and/or delivers recommendations for improving processes and/or technologies including defining impact and outcome criteria, conducts interviews and product analysis to gather user requirements and submits enhancement recommendations for review and/or approval, and working with staff from BIPIN member agencies. Participates in evaluating and recommending new technologies, and provides technical advice and support to BIPIN users in the appropriate use of technology. This position shares responsibility, on a scheduled basis, to provide after-hours support.
This position is a two level series. The IT Business Analyst - BIPIN II is distinguished from the IT Business Analyst - BIPIN I by the increased complexity of assignments, the greater degree of independence with which it operates, the business and technical experience required to perform the work, and the years of service with the City.

Job Description
BASIC JOB PURPOSE
: Call the Car is seeking a Call Center Business Analyst Manager specializing in call center reporting, Workforce Management (WFM), and forecasting. This role will play a critical role in analyzing and optimizing the performance of the call center. The role demands a unique blend of analytical, technical, and managerial skills. This role requires at least 5-8 years of experience in a call center or call center environment, specifically focusing on reporting, WFM, forecasting, and analytics. A proven track record in driving operational improvements, optimizing workforce utilization, and enhancing overall call center performance is highly valued. Five9 WFM/WFO experience is required.
TYPICAL WORKING CONDITIONS
: Office environment. May require light travel, evening and/or weekend work. The position may require long periods of sitting, standing, kneeling, bending, and lifting at least 25 lbs.
RESPONSIBILITES/DUTIES
:
Monitor call center performance by analysing performance statistics and data; identify trends, gaps, and areas for improvement.
Evaluate and make recommendations regarding production, productivity, quality, and customer-service standards.
Complete audits and determine system improvements; assist with implementing the appropriate changes.
Own the relationship with Five9 and implement changes.
Prepare and maintain in-depth call center analysis/reporting/dashboards and present recommendations to management.
Clearly and effectively convey issues, reports, and other deliverables to management.
Performance Requirements
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
Bachelor's degree in business administration, information technology or related degree with 5 plus years of experience in a business analysis of call center systems
Analytical Skills: Proficiency in analyzing call center data, KPIs, and performance metrics to derive insights and recommend strategies for operational improvement. Ability to use data to identify trends, patterns, and areas for enhancement.
Experience in Reporting and Analytics: In-depth expertise in call center reporting tools and methodologies. This includes generating and interpreting reports on key operational metrics, agent performance, service levels, and other relevant data.
Workforce Management (WFM) Expertise: Strong understanding of WFM principles, such as forecasting call volumes, scheduling staff, and managing resources efficiently to meet service level objectives.
Forecasting Skills: Proven ability to create accurate forecasts for call volumes, staffing needs, and resource allocation based on historical data, trends, and other relevant factors.
Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with WFM software, call center technologies, and proficiency in relevant tools and software used for reporting, analytics, and forecasting.
Communication and Presentation: Strong communication skills to convey complex data insights to various stakeholders, including upper management, in a clear and concise manner. The ability to present findings and recommendations effectively is crucial.
Project Management: Capability to manage and lead projects focused on improving call center efficiency, forecasting accuracy, or implementing new tools or processes.
Problem-Solving Abilities: Skilled in identifying operational challenges and implementing effective solutions to improve call center performance, productivity, and service quality.
Collaboration and Team Leadership: Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams, providing guidance, and leading a team of analysts to achieve common goals.
Adaptability and Continuous Learning: Ability to adapt to changing technology and industry trends, while continuously seeking opportunities for learning and professional development.
ACCOMMODATION
: Call the Car has the right to modify the duties and functions of the job description based on the needs of the organization.

At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.
Come develop great software solutions to solve exciting problems to help patients!
The Software Product Engineering team is actively looking for a Business Analyst. Are you determined to deliver the best user-centered solutions? Are you interested in shaping the next generation of application development? If so, please apply.
What You’ll Be Doing
As a business analyst focused on patient engagement applications, you will be responsible for the successful delivery of those applications by facilitating the agile software development process, identifying product requirements based on stakeholder input, and identifying and implementing process improvements. These products will meet patients where they are at due to your close collaboration with our user-experience team, product owners, and other cross-functional stakeholders. You will partner with peers to influence the development process as we scale, to create an impactful operation that is responsive to both business and patient needs.
How You’ll Succeed
As business analyst you will gather, understand, and analyze the needs of project stakeholders; formalize the needs into a set of actionable business requirements.
With an approach that accepts failure, and ability to work in ambiguity, you will collaborate with the development team to translate business needs into technical requirements
By maximizing your understanding of the agile development methodology, you will manage the product backlog alongside the team scrum master to ensure the team is working on prioritized features in each product release
Using your problem-solving skills, you will evaluate the impact of proposed software changes to the software products, and create a clear path forward for the delivery team to successfully implement the changes
With an attention to detail and proactivity you will identify, resolve, and prevent impediments to the delivery of the software products that you support; closely collaborating with internal and external teams to ensure effective resolution of issues.
Using your understanding of compliance needs you will create and support the validation activities of our applications to ensure we adhere to the validation requirements of Lilly’s Quality Management System(s)
As a superb communicator with strong interpersonal skills, you will work and collaborate effectively on a team including with remote team members, to define, design and shape new features.

Familiarity with RESTful APIs
Demonstrated ability to write user stories based on business and/or technical needs
Consistent track record of using Agile software development concepts to deliver software products over multiple releases
Ability to navigate through a software product release where new delivery processes are being defined, and new technologies are being produced
Familiarity with working in a regulated environment where quality of development activities is as important as the quality of the software
Demonstrated use of agile software tools such as Jira and Confluence to accomplish translating business/technical needs into requirements

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or related technical field
Or
High School Diploma/GED with 7+ years of experience in IT technical roles
Professional experience in delivering software solutions that span the development life cycle; i.e., project initiation, design, development, testing, deployment, maintenance, support, and retirement

Experience with Agile principles and frameworks across an applications lifecycle

Lilly IT builds and maintains capabilities using groundbreaking technologies like most prominent tech companies. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver innovative solutions in every area of our business.

OFFICE OF HEALTH STRATEGY (OHS)
SCOPE OF WORK
The Office of Health Strategy seeks a Business Analyst who will assist the Office of Health Strategy and the Department of Social Services in improving business processes related to Race, Ethnicity, and Language (REL) data collection as a result of PA 21-35 specifically section 11, and to produce a health equity dashboard based on REL Data. This is a timeboxed three-month engagement.
Who is OHS?
The Office of Health Strategy (OHS) is a state agency based in Hartford. The mission of OHS is to implement comprehensive, data-driven strategies that promote equal access to high-quality health care, control costs, and ensure better health outcomes for all Connecticut residents.
CAUSE OF ACTION
The legislation PA 21-35 mandates uniform collection of REL data to support the Commission on Racial Equity in Public Health's mission to create a comprehensive strategic plan to eliminate health disparities and inequities across sectors. Availability of REL data is critical to accomplish this goal. REL data will support development of targeted interventions to reduce racial disparities, and augment health care providers' continuous efforts to provide high quality, effective, timely, patient-centered, equitable care to all patients, in Connecticut. The REL standards document enumerates how to uniformly collect and code self-reported race, ethnicity, and language by clients/patients. Please visit
REL (ct.gov)
for an overview of the REL Data Collection mandate and data standards.
DUTIES
The Business Analyst will analyze the current state of data management operations relative to Race, Ethnicity, and Language Data Collection. To perform this analysis the incumbent will analyze three patient data systems managed by the Office of Health Strategy and other systems managed by Department of Social Services.
The Chosen Business Analyst Will
successfully conduct a stakeholder focused requirements building process.
engage with key stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate requirements into technical specifications.
asses existing technical and process requirements.
assess current state of data modeling and design.
write business, functional, and technical requirements of new database model and design for each system.
analyze current database systems to identify improvements and optimizations for the collection and reporting of REL Databases from impacted systems.
develop project plan for updating system.
develop strategies for database implementation and data acquisition.
present requirements and solution recommendations to staff.
DELIVERABLES
The analysis will culminate in recommendations to improve data collection, data quality, and data reporting of REL Data collected and housed within impacted systems.
A project plan to update current REL Data Systems at the Office of Health Strategy and DSS, successfully implement the plan for REL data collection, and produce a health equity dashboard.

Experience with analysis of data models and computer applications.
Experience writing project plans and other project management documentation.

Formulate alternative solutions to satisfy these requirements, which may involve business process reengineering, and/or the deployment of information technology. Conduct and document the results of special studies dealing with systems and/or business process issues. Facilitate sessions to gather and document requirements and explore solutions. Superior negotiating, analytical, group facilitation, and relationship management skills. Work effectively with all levels of State staff from clerical through agency executive management. This includes skillful interviewing capability. Possess superior organizational and written/verbal communication skills. Hands-on Data Modeling and Process Modeling experience may be required for some assignments.
An understanding of current information technology with an ability to conceptualize solutions to business problems in the most effective and cost-efficient manner.
(Note: Current information technology in the State's environment includes:
multi-tier (mainframe, departmental/midlevel, and desktop) computing;
the use of internet and intranet to facilitate service delivery;
electronic data interchange;
imaging;
data warehousing; and,
geographic information systems.

Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract.

Role Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Business Technical Analyst (Manufacturing Systems) to join our dynamic team onsite in our plant in Normal, IL. As a Manufacturing Systems Business Technical Analyst, you will play a crucial role in analyzing, evaluating, and improving our manufacturing systems and processes. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for system enhancements, optimize efficiency, and drive continuous improvement. The ideal candidate should possess a strong background in manufacturing systems, business analysis, and possess exceptional problem-solving skills.
This role will be located onsite in our Manufacturing Plant in Normal, IL
Responsibilities
Analyze manufacturing processes, systems, and workflows to identify areas for improvement and optimization.
Collaborate with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to understand requirements and gather relevant data.
Evaluate existing manufacturing systems and identify areas for enhancement, integration, or replacement.
Develop and maintain detailed documentation, including system requirements, process maps, user manuals, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Collaborate with IT teams to design, configure, and implement changes to manufacturing systems, ensuring seamless integra:on and minimal disruption.
Perform system testing, validation, and troubleshooting to ensure proper functionality and adherence to requirements.
Provide training and support to end-users, ensuring they understand and can effectively utilize manufacturing systems.
Monitor system performance, collect and analyze data to identify and address issues, and propose solutions to enhance system reliability and efficiency.
Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends in manufacturing systems and recommend innovative solutions to drive continuous improvement.
Collaborate with vendors and external partners to evaluate, select, and implement new manufacturing systems or upgrades.
Lead or participate in cross-functional projects to improve manufacturing processes, reduce costs, increase productivity, and enhance overall operational efficiency.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
2-5 years of experience working as a Business Analyst, Technical Analyst, or similar role in a manufacturing or industrial environment is required.
Strong understanding of manufacturing systems, processes, and workflows.
Proficient in system analysis, process mapping, and requirements gathering.
Experience with manufacturing software and systems such as Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems.
Familiarity with database concepts, SQL, and data analysis tools.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify issues, propose solutions, and drive change.
Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast-paced environment
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with a keen attention to detail.

job_summary:
At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.
Organization
Overview
Lilly Research Labs plays a critical role in progressing the Lilly pipeline and driving the delivery of medicines from the time molecules leave the scientific research environment through product launch. Lilly Research Labs IT (LRL IT) is responsible for establishing the information management and technologies to enable the future capabilities of LRL, for delivery of solutions to meet approved information management and technology initiatives, and for the stability of the current solutions to meet evolving business needs. Within LRL IT, our Clinical Design and Operations team helps speed innovation to patients by ensuring effective clinical trial management and interactions with study site locations through the delivery of sound benefit-risk science that ultimately enables the right treatment to the right patient at the right time.
Key Objectives and Work You’re Doing
Are you curious about the processes for managing the clinical trials that evaluate the efficacy of Lilly products? Would you like to partner with clinical trial practitioners to make lives better for patients? Join our Clinical Design and Operations team and you can learn what it takes. LRL IT provides technology solutions to business problems by defining, influencing, and developing solutions to achieve Lilly’s strategic outcomes.
This Agile Business Analyst position is responsible for working on the design, development, configuration, testing, and implementation of projects supporting key clinical trial capabilities. Specifically, this role will collaborate with LRL IT, business partners, and multiple suppliers to deliver major releases of applications throughout the year. To that end, this role entails the following responsibilities.
Work as a member of an Agile team with business representatives, vendors, and IT team members to develop requirements and design for clinical operations applications.
Perform technical implementation of the Vault Clinical SaaS application using the framework of the Veeva Vault configuration standards and best practices.
Perform test management activities and provide leadership for test execution.
Work closely with business partners using an Agile framework to identify and understand the business needs, challenges, and risks and translate them to IT project requests/requirements.
Understand the clinical operations business areas, processes, strategies and supporting data to deliver application and reporting solutions.
Responsible for defining and managing requirements and ensuring they are in-line with customer expectations and understood by both business and IT.
Participate in the development of project estimates & timelines.
Authoring and/or reviewing of validation deliverables.
Participate in requirements workshops, design, prototype, configuration activities to develop and document solutions to meet the business requirements.
To be successful in this role, you will need to be skilled at building relationships, have an interest in building a technical foundation, and have high learning agility paired with the ability to translate business processes into technical concepts.
Specific Objectives For This Role Include
Grow your business skills by understanding the end-to-end business process to which technology is being applied and understanding how the customer will use that technology.
Grow your technical skills by learning and implementing the technology used in solution(s), understanding data flows and timing, and end-to-end technical tools and dependencies.
Develop technology solutions within environments governed by Quality Management Systems (QMS) utilizing iterative development methodologies and repeatable processes.
Influence decisions both internally and externally with vendor partners.
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree
2+ years Agile principles and frameworks experience
Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States. Lilly does not anticipate providing sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B or TN status) for this employment position.
Additional Skills/Preferences
Bachelor's degree in information management, business, computer science or related technical field
Experience with software development life cycle, spanning the lifecycle from project initiation to development, testing, and deployment.
Understand the Agile development processes and be familiar with requirements gathering techniques (i.e. users stories, backlog, story point assignment).
Good social, teamwork, and self-management skills.
Demonstrated agility to learn new technology, solve business issues, and influence others to adopt.
Experience with HP ALM and JIRA.
Familiarity with Software Quality Assurance methods and techniques.
Familiarity with Veeva Vault configuration framework.
Ability to accomplish results through others, particularly by establishing relationships, and being an effective team member and business partner.

This role is located in Indianapolis, IN with a hybrid work model (relocation required).

Skills Required
Agile Project Management Manages projects within Information Technology (IT) or other functions in a highly flexible and interactive manner, in line with best practice agile principles.
Business Requirements Analysis Recognizes, evaluates, and records the key requirements of a business problem that needs to be resolved or a business objective that needs to be met.
Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborates with team members from different teams or functions to reach a common goal, or responsibility, or complete a project.
Data Analysis Quantifies information and sorts it for analysis. Analyzes data which may include investigating and highlighting trends, presenting, reporting on results, and providing conclusions and recommendations. Uses the appropriate tools (e.g., Excel) to conduct the analysis.
Data Gathering & Reporting Uses varied tools, techniques, and processes for gathering and reporting data. Knows which data to collect and what would be useful to report on.
Data Governance Ensures high data quality exists throughout the complete data lifecycle. The key focus areas include availability, usability, consistency, data integrity, and data security.
Data Modeling Documents a complex software system design as an easily understood diagram, using text and symbols to represent the way data needs to flow. Uses the diagram to ensure efficient use of data, as a blueprint for the construction of new software or for re-engineering a legacy application.

User Acceptance Testing Conducts testing to verify/accept a software system before moving the application to the production environment. Validates end-to-end business flow. Verifies that the created solution/software works for “the user.”

THE ROLE: Business Analyst, Rights Solutions
The Business Analyst, Rights Solutions will be primarily responsible for Rights Technology solutions within A+E Networks Technology department. In this role, you will play a crucial part in the analysis, design, and implementation of technology solutions that support our Rights-related processes. You will work closely with various stakeholders to gather and document requirements, facilitate effective communication between business and technology teams, ensure successful delivery of rights technology projects, and be an integral part of legacy platform transformation program.
More About What You’ll Do
Business Analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis of business processes and workflows related to Rights systems. Collaborate with stakeholders, including business managers, development teams, and technology professionals, to translate their needs into actionable requirements.
Requirements Gathering: Elicit and document both functional and non-functional requirements for Rights technology projects. Define use cases, user stories, and acceptance criteria to ensure clear communication and understanding among stakeholders.
Solution Design: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, designers, and project managers, to design and document technology solutions. Visualize and communicate proposed solutions using wireframes, prototypes, and process flow diagrams.
Communication: Facilitate effective communication between business stakeholders and technical teams. Bridge the gap between business and technology perspectives, ensuring accurate translation of requirements and alignment with business needs.
Testing and Quality Assurance: Collaborate with QA teams to define test plans and test cases for rights technology projects. Participate in testing activities, review test results, and ensure the quality and functionality of implemented solutions.
Production Support: Work closely with Rights business and technology operation teams to provide support for existing business systems. Respond promptly to business stakeholders, identifying areas for technology improvements and increased efficiency.
User Training: Provide user training and support during the implementation of Rights technology solutions. Create user manuals, guides, and documentation to facilitate smooth adoption and ongoing usage of systems.
Project Management: Aid in project planning, estimation, and tracking of Rights technology projects. Collaborate with project managers to ensure on-time delivery, manage risks, and communicate project status to stakeholders.
What You’ll Learn
On our team, you'll have the opportunity to innovate and learn. You will learn. You will not be alone. You’ll have an opportunity to build transformational technology solutions & supporting core areas of business. Also, you’ll be able to seek out new technologies and implement them where they make sense. Finally, you’ll be exposed to various A+E departments and stakeholders to learn the goals, needs and direction so you can become a trusted partner.

A minimum of 5 years of experience in managing and supporting enterprise systems.

Demonstrated excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex business requirements into technology solutions.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, enabling effective collaboration with stakeholders at various levels.

The Senior Analyst – IT Business Analyst (“Business Analyst”) acts as a liaison between the business community and the Information Technology (IT) organization to provide business analysis service while working as part of a project team. The business analyst will work with the project manager to help deliver IT-related projects with our business partners. The Business Analyst will focus on ensuring that business requirements relating to technology are defined and addressed as well as identifying and evaluating relevant technology solutions to solve business problems, exploit opportunities, and drive forward continuous improvements assuring the realization of business benefits. The Business Analyst will undertake the methodical investigation, analysis, review, and documentation of business functions and processes to create viable specifications and acceptance criteria.
JOB FUNCTIONS AND KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Work with the business and other stakeholders to elicit, analyze, document, verify, prioritize, and validate requirements (user, functional, non-functional, integration, data, security, deployment, training, and support requirements)

Develop business process models (as-is and to-be) and documentation
Balance technology and business issues as well as communicate appropriately with both technology and business subject matter experts
Develop, define, and build technology bias business cases that will enable business and technology change
Critically evaluate information gathered from multiple stakeholders to reconcile conflicts, decompose high-level information into detailed requirements, and distinguish between user requests and true needs
Make sure that documented requirements and functional design are clear, concise, and unambiguous
Transition approved requirements and functional design documents to the development team
Serve as the conduit between the business community, development team, and any third-party companies through which requirements flow
Assist in translating requirements and use cases into test conditions and expected results for product, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing
Facilitate the creation of user acceptance test scripts with business stakeholders and consult with developers and/or subject matter experts as necessary
Oversee user acceptance testing, track defects, and resolution of defects to ensure all outstanding issues are known and accepted before deployment
Produce and manage critical project artifacts such as requirements specification, requirements traceability matrix, functional design, user acceptance test scripts, and training materials
Facilitate workgroup meetings, including coordination of agendas and documentation of meeting minutes
Assist with PMO reporting and tasks as needed
Develop and support a knowledge management culture within IT and other parts of the organization
Perform all responsibilities within IT policies and directives at or above performance and evaluation standards

Golden Pass LNG is an ExxonMobil (30%) and QatarEnergy (70%) joint venture formed in the early 2000s to import liquefied natural gas. In 2019, the shareholders made a $10B final investment decision for “The Golden Pass LNG Export Project” (GPX) to construct a world-class LNG export facility.
From inception to date, substantially all technology systems and services have been provided by ExxonMobil IT (EMIT). As part of the GPX project, the company launched an IT Enablement initiative to carve out systems from EMIT and establish standalone systems and processes designed specifically for LNG export operations in a green field environment. The IT Enablement initiatives will utilize current cloud technology and Software-as-a-Service to the extent possible. Golden Pass IT professionals will focus on strategic initiatives and business differentiators and manage service providers to maintain systems and perform recurring, tactical tasks.
Golden Pass LNG is seeking a highly motivated Business Analyst (BA) focused on SAP S/4 (Finance and Procurement processes) to join our growing IT team. BA will play a critical role in optimizing and enhancing our financial and procurement processes. BA will collaborate with cross-functional teams, gathering requirements and implementing SAP solutions that align with our business objectives.

As a team player, the Business Analyst will be responsible for the following across 3 key themes.
Requirements
The BA is the team owner of requirements documentation and elicitation. Instead of being the “liaison” between the team the product owner, you are the “glue” that brings them together.

During the iterations, work on making sure the stories, test cases and business rules are clear, accessible and understood by the business and developers for all stories.

The New York City Department of Transportation’s (NYC DOT) provides safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of pedestrians, goods, and vehicular traffic on the streets, highways, bridges, and waterways of the City's transportation network. NYC DOT rehabilitates and maintains the City's infrastructure, including bridges, tunnels, streets, sidewalks, and highways.
The NYC DOT IT & Telecom division is an award-winning team leading business transformation through technology innovation to enhance the agency’s ability in fulfilling its mission. IT & Telecom acts as a strategic partner with all business units to promote technology initiatives by delivering quality service, and secure solutions that provide new and improved capabilities for the Agency. We work hard to embrace diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone in the division to bring their authentic selves to work every day.
We offer our full-time employee’s competitive salaries, excellent benefit options and perks that include:
Pension and Retirement Plans- Upon retirement, qualified members of the City’s generous pension program receive a guaranteed salary and health benefits for the rest of their lives. There are also 401K and 457 plans available to supplement your retirement needs.
Health Coverage- We offer health coverage to meet your needs and your family.
Dental and Vision Coverage- We offer a wide variety of excellent civil service title-based union dental and vision coverage to meet the needs of you and your family.
Paid Time Off- We offer paid vacation and sick time off which accrues over time based on your years of service.
Professional Development - We offer numerous training programs, leadership development opportunities, and career coaching services, while encouraging employees to attend approved off and on-site trainings and seminars.
Additional Perks - Our employees are eligible for discounts on top theme parks, hotels, shows, events, movies and more
New York City Department of Transportation’s Information Technology & Telecom unit is seeking a Senior IT Business Analyst to join our Project Management Office (PMO). The Project Management Office is known for building large scale, web-based, workflow applications that either replace legacy systems or help to implement a new work stream at DOT. At a project’s inception, you will work directly with project stakeholders to gain an in-depth understanding of their business processes, identify stakeholder’s current pain points, conduct workflow analysis, and then thoroughly document this information and confirm it with the stakeholders. After initial analysis and documentation is completed, you will then perform requirements gathering and document the software specifications. During development, you will perform in-depth requirements, and functional testing, report and prioritize defects in the product backlog. Post-deployment you will provide application support to the users. Throughout the entire software development process, you will work closely with a team comprised of a project manager, an architect, application developers, a quality assurance specialist, and possibly other business analysts.
To be successful in this role, you’ll need to be:
A customer service champion with the overall goal of delivering on the customer’s needs.
Skilled in data analysis, transformation, and strategies.
Adept to Agile and Waterfall software development methodologies.
Able to quickly and continuously learn new technologies and applications.
Patient with an aptitude for explaining technical information to audiences with different levels of technical knowledge.
A person who embraces both the opportunities and challenges that technology present.
Well versed in managing changing priorities and competing deadlines.
Major Responsibilities
Be the liaison between the application development team and the project stakeholders.
Analyze as-is systems, business processes and operational procedures.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements.
Write and maintain software requirements specification documents.
Create and manage the product backlog.
Effectively communicate software requirements to technical staff.
Create UML diagrams that improve the business and technical teams understanding of requirements.
Perform data analysis by querying relational databases using SQL and Microsoft Excel.
Perform functional testing, and requirements testing, as well as collaborate with quality assurance specialists to ensure only high-quality software is delivered.
Report and prioritize defects found during quality assurance and user acceptance testing cycles.
Support technology adaptation by conducting training sessions, providing training materials and establishing feedback loops.
Troubleshoot reported software issues and perform incident management.
Provide application support directly to DOT application
Minimum Qualifications
A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college in computer science, engineering, human computer interaction, interactive media, digital and graphics design, data visualization, communication or a related field, and four years of satisfactory full-time experience related to the area(s) required by the particular position and a specialization in a relevant technology, process, methodology and/or domain; or
An associate degree from an accredited college in computer science, engineering, human computer interaction, interactive media, digital and graphics design, data visualization, communication or a related field, and six years of satisfactory full-time experience related to the area(s) required by the particular position and a specialization in a relevant technology, process, methodology and/or domain; or
A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college, and eight years of satisfactory full-time experience related to the area(s) required by the particular position and a specialization in a relevant technology, process, methodology and/or domain; or
Education and/or experience which is equivalent to "1", "2", or "3" above.
Preferred Skills
5+ years of experience in business analysis, or product management. - 5+ years of experience in gathering and documenting business and software requirements. - 3+ years of data analysis experience by querying relational databases using SQL. - 1+ year of designing wireframes, or prototypes. - Familiarity and foundational understanding of geospatial data, and map interfaces. - Proficient with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio. - Experience with Power Apps, Service Now, Salesforce, and Microsoft Access. - Familiarity with JIRA and Azure DevOps platforms. - Experience with creating testing plans and performing different types of quality assurance testing.
